fato_historico: 1991: Ötzi the Iceman is discovered in the Alps on the border between Italy and Austria.
energia_do_dia: Much like a traveler uncovering a frozen treasure from the ancient Alps, today you may discover long-forgotten facets of your brilliant personality. It is a good time to melt the icy barriers around your heart and let your curiosity lead you toward unexpected wisdom. Consider the depth of your soul and embrace the mysterious, icy magic of your own hidden potential.
frase_do_dia: The greatest treasures are often found when we dare to look beneath the surface.
significado_numero: Represents a transition between old cycles and brand new beginnings.
conselho: Stay curious and let your intuition guide you through uncharted territories today.
